title: Hearty Mustardy Greek Morning Glory Gigantes Plaki
description: A quick-fix Greek dish featuring morning-glory-pak-bung in a mustardy lacquer glaze, perfect for a satisfying meal. This ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is a twist on traditional gigantes plaki.

ingredients.name: morning glory
ingredients.notes: also known as pak bung or water spinach

instructions: Rinse the morning glory and cut it into 2-inch pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the morning glory and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mustard, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the mustard mixture over the morning glory and stir to combine.
Add the tomato paste and vegetable broth, and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the sauce has thickened, about 10 minutes.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently to combine.
Cook until the eggs are set, about 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
